shortDescription: GitHub-style profile overview view for a developer account.
fullDescription: Presents the github-user-profile-overview view in its default state with a dark GitHub-inspired top bar, interactive profile navigation tabs, a left profile summary column, a popular repositories grid, and a yearly contribution heatmap with selectable year pills. The view exposes state and tab arguments and keeps visible controls such as the global search field, tab buttons, year selection, and contribution cells interactive through local presentational state.
